newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen cotton buyers fret over prices.
newsitem.headline: Bremen cotton buyers fret over prices.

text.p: European spinning mills baulked at origin shipping prices and only bought selective grades and volumes, the Bremen Cotton Exchange's fortnightly report said on Monday.
Egyptian 1996/97 opening prices were perceived as too high, given the competitive world market situation.
Reported spot trades included Central Asian cottons 3,4, and 5, and Indian medium grades.
West African descriptions, Greek higher grades, Zimbabwe cotton, Israel-Acala and California SJV traded for dates up to fourth quarter 1997.
